title: Related Questions
question: Related Questions Q. Dream 1337 views Q. What is meaning of first chapter/verse of qasida burdah, wording is as under. 1. Maula ya salle wassaleem daye man abdan, allah habibika khairul khalke khullhi meen. 1977 views Q. I was on my business tour few days back traveling from Mumbai to Chennai. While sleeping in the train I saw that I was with some person in some far lonely place surrounded by mountains 1322 views Q. I have asked this question before, but you did not answer, Kindly answer this time. I am engaged to a girl who is my cousin and my marriage is going to happen very soon, I wanted to know the interpretation of my dream- " In the dream, I am saying to my parents that i don't want to marry her, later on her parents also come to know about my intension, but after some time i again regret my decision and tell my parents that i made a mistake, i want to marry the same girl(ie., my cousin)".. please give the meaning of this dream, i was very worried after seeing this kind of dream, because i liked this girl and told my parents of my intention, everything is of my choice and will only, but seeing this kind of dream is making me worried. 1407 views Q. What would it mean if there wasa dream were i think i saw umar r.a and i think it was him and i noticed he had a long bridge nose and grey hair. ther was also more details about the roomand more. 1350 views Q. Dear Mufti Saahab, May Allah(SWT) bless you with the best for the work you are doing. Few days ago a very pious person passed away in our town. He was not a Aalim or Haafeez but a Daaiee who was involved very much in the work of Daawaah. I wasn't there in my town during that time neither was I close to this person during his hayaat but, use to see him often while going and coming from prayers. Coming to the point. I with my family and my brother-in-law were discussing about this person after which we went to sleep. I dreamt about the person who passed away that "It is a time for prayers (Don't remember which prayer but, I feel Magrib) and this person is asking me to lead the prayers and upon his saying I led the prayers and I started reciting aayaahs (Qiraat) and I remember that I was stopping after each aayaah and was very slow in recitation (Don't remember which aayaahs). This person whom I am talking about, in the state of Salaah started reading the Aayaahs louder and little faster and I taught he is prompting me and even I started reciting it fast. Please interpret this dream of mine (Jazaakumullah). 1528 views Q. I want to know tabeer of my dream that everytime i see a dream that i was on the railway station and my freinds and sometime my parents with me and every time i miss the train what does this dream actually mean? 1849 views Q. Assalamu alaikum wrbk, I am from holy Makkah al Mukarrama I saw in my dream I am going on the street lot of lions comes and pass near by me no one lion harm me I am seeing lot of lions going in front of me like goats groups I saw this dream lot of times lions and tigers etc please reply me jazk Allah Qair Allah SWT know the best insha Allah 1522 views Q. Dream Interpretation 1887 views Q. I used to see that I went inside earth (zameen) and there I saw few people unknown 1502 views Q. I would like to say firstly brother.. I have sent you a couple of messages before.. i have not yet recieved my answers. Could you please reply back to me about them a.s.a.p. Secondly, What is the significance of seeing a masjid in a dream?.. In mu dream, my uncle told me to go to somebody's house, instead of going to the house, I walked towards a big mosque. I just stood there and i was just staring at it. Please let me know what this means. 1207 views Q. Assalamualaikum 1-My student wants to know the meaning of a dream. He saw a dream that there were alot of spiders (dangerous and non dangerous) and spider webs in his room,he killed most of the spiders and some were left to kill then he woke up what does the dream mean? 1620 views Q. As Salaam alykum, I want to know the meaning of one dream my husband saw He saw he has turned almost bald(only few hairs on head) and then someone told that there is this oil in the shop which can bring it back,after that he cant remember.. Please interpret this dream according to your knowledge. Jazakhumakhair. 1427 views Q. I saw a dream that i have gone blind in one eye / or it was a feeling that i cannot see from one eye . what does this mean? 2836 views Q. Please interpret the following dream for me. Rasulullah (SAW) is returning after being exiled from Madinah 1455 views
